purpose: Present two contrasting sides of the same thing.
keywords: Plain clause / Nである / な-adjectiveな + 反面
This town is convenient, but rents are high.
Working from home offers freedom but can also feel lonely.
He is strict, but he is also caring when you need help.
formation: Plain clause / Nである / な-adjectiveな + 反面
restrictions: Usually contrasts properties of one subject.
mistake: Use 一方で for broader contrasts between different subjects.
